Algebra 2 · Unit 7: Exponential and Logarithmic Functions

Exponential Growth and Decay

Model growth and decay, including compound and continuous interest.

What you’ll learn

  • Write growth and decay models
  • Use compound and continuous interest formulas
  • Compare exponential and linear models
  • Identify initial values and growth or decay factors
  • Solve for time with logarithms

The mountain biking connection

A shock’s rebound peaks shrinking by the same fraction each cycle, or a race series’ entries growing each season.

Learning activities

Interactive lab

Suspension & Systems Lab

Model a shock’s shrinking rebound peaks as a geometric sequence and a continuous e-based envelope, forecast a trail festival’s registrations, and use logarithms, log properties and change of base to decode decibels and solve for time.

Level
Intermediate to Advanced
Time
20-25 min
  • 3 missions
  • Suspension decay simulator
  • Event growth simulator and target calculator
  • Decibel analyzer and logarithm workbench
  • Final Engineering Report (12)
  • Optional advanced engineering bench

Practices here: Compare exponential and linear models; Identify initial values and growth or decay factors; Write growth and decay models; Solve for time with logarithms
